subject: POC plan & timeline for Acme Industries – next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed POC plan (Acme Industries)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our side so we can get the POC (trial) scheduled:

Summary of scope
- Evaluate Redwood inference on Acme's internal search and triage pipeline (500k monthly queries, median length ~120 tokens).
- Success criteria: 1) latency p95 <= 350ms for single-request endpoints; 2) embedding similarity quality >= 0.85 on your eval set; 3) cost per 1k tokens under target after batching/quantization.

Proposed POC plan
- Kickoff: Wed Jun 23 — 1-hour technical kickoff (Redwood + Acme infra + data owners).
- Week 1: infra & access — VPC peering / sample dataset ingestion / baseline run.
- Week 2: quality tuning — prompt sets, embeddings evaluation, metric dashboards.
- Week 3: performance tuning — batching, caching, quantization recommendations.
- Final readout: Wed Jul 14 — demo + results + recommended next steps.

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa (sales lead) + Marcus (solutions/infra) + Monica (customer success)
- Acme: Alex (engineering lead) + Samantha (data owner)

Attachments: Redwood-POC-plan.pdf (detailed timeline + SOW), Acme-eval-criteria.xlsx (sample eval set template)

Next steps
1) Please confirm the kickoff date/time (we've penciled Jun 23 10am PT).
2) Share any internal contacts to include or compliance blockers upfront.

Happy to adjust — thanks!
\Best,
\Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

- Kickoff: Jun 23 at 10am PT works for us.
- Success criteria: agree on the latency and embedding thresholds; will add a 4th success criteria around memory/kv cache stability (we need no OOMs on 16GB GPUs during peak loads).
